fortnight.description: Two small Git repositories with cross-cutting fixes, a superseded guarantee, corrected measurements, later commits and dirty work.

criteria.requirement: Explain that the new shared CSV exporter resumes saved batch checkpoints; replayed sends require destination deduplication. Two real apps consume it. PDF recovery is outside the window; do not claim a fleet deployment.
Include cleanup of obsolete archive chunks and repair of dropped query parameters, despite generic maintenance subjects and adjacent cosmetic changes. Separate these outcomes.
Explain the shared notification integration and retrying the saved delivery outcome without sending again. Do not merge it with exports merely because both are packages.
Do not claim the booking's seat reservation and record are atomic: the later rewrite uses separate writes. Exclude or accurately qualify the superseded repair.

Lead with working-app completion within budget: Client A 5/5, Client B 2/5, combined 7/10; two B results unverified. Browser-only confirmation is 8/10. Rechecking unchanged artifacts is not evidence of product improvement from 2/10 to 8/10.

Describe narrower application authorization while retaining permitted account metadata reads. Lifetime constants do not enforce expiry. Shared login has a fail-open consumer and non-atomic nonce consumption; do not claim reliable restricted access or single-use handoffs.
Recount two baseline packages and four cutoff packages; generated copies and tests are not consumers or extra packages.
Use June 2–15 inclusive UTC and count the Core alias once. Do not promote the later PDF addition or dirty deployment claim into the report. Existing HTML rendering is not a new framework.
No real hosted guides or demos exist for these fictional projects. Omit invented destinations and machine-specific evidence links from reader prose; record this limit separately.

compression.description: Reduce a supplied update by approximately one third without losing its results, context or adoption limits.

criteria.requirement: Keep Client A 5/5 and Client B 2/5 within budget, 7/10 combined, and two unverified B results. Do not substitute 8/10 browser confirmation or imply a causal product improvement.
Keep CSV-only checkpoint recovery, PDF restart behavior, and shared-login fail-open/non-atomic limits.
Remove procedure and repeated explanations before compressing core messages; retain natural complete sentences and understandable components.
